_readme: Every number in chapter-4-draft.docx comes from this file. 'auto' blocks are written by ch4-data.py from the run files named in 'source'; everything else is hand-kept and carries its own source string. A tier with 'pending' and no 'source' prints its pending marker.

environment.source: docs/desktop-runs/2026-09-30-mp-50k.md section 1 (branch docs/ch4-study-2026-09-30); journal line 1 of every run
rows: 31.9 GB on the host; 24 GB allotted to WSL2 (docker_info.MemTotal 25,199,009,792 bytes), swap off
Docker Desktop data disk on the Kingston NVMe solid-state drive; LevelDB state database
Windows 11 Pro 10.0.26200; WSL2 Ubuntu 26.04, kernel 6.18.33.2-microsoft-standard-WSL2; Docker Desktop 4.90.0, server 29.7.2
Hyperledger Fabric 2.5.15 test network, channel saksi, chaincode saksi-bulletin, single Raft orderer
BatchTimeout 2 s, MaxMessageCount 50, PreferredMaxBytes 2 MB, AbsoluteMaxBytes 99 MB
Two organizations with one peer each and one Raft orderer, all on the one machine; a fresh network and empty ledger for every attempt (network reset)
Console Go 1.23.4; saksi and console at commit 4a38a54; saksi-demo SHA-256 112fffa0...763c52 in all 119 study runs
None (HostConfig.Memory 0, NanoCpus 0 on every container); 16 vCPU visible to Docker
Closed loop, 128 ballots in flight, no send-rate cap (send_rate 0); verifier on 16 threads

election_config.text: 4 candidates per position, 5 trustees with threshold 3, realistic selection distribution, on-chain mode
election_config.source: campaign.json config of each tier export

tiers.name: MP-50K
tiers.note: rerun interrupted by a power loss before any measured repetition; attempt 1 stands

tiers.name: SP-483K
tiers.planned: 1 + 3, then rate sweep and peak burst

sweep_burst.plan: send rate 250 /s, factor 1.6, step window 120 s (offers 250, 400, 640, 1,024, 1,638 /s); burst 144,900 voters (Zamboanga City's 483,058 voters over 10 h is 48,300 per hour; worst-case hour taken as three times that)

candidates.source_note: Night 1 candidate-count check: MP-1K at 10 and 28 candidates per position (2 warm-ups + 5 measured), against the 2026-09-30 MP-1K campaign at 4 candidates (2 + 10).
candidates.contention_note: Both Night 1 campaigns are the standing second attempts and are flagged for host CPU above 25 % on measured repetitions (a web browser running on the host): cand10 on 3 of 5, cand28 on 2 of 5. The 4-candidate campaign ran a night earlier.
